MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

2. Best practice when working on Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble.

8. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software.: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software..

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Instrumental Transpositions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Setting Text to Music and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Four-Part Harmony and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Music Notation Software. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. A — Practise Kenyan -Western Instrumental Ensemble with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. A — Practise Western Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. B — Red, blue, and yellow

5. D — Practise Contemporary Dances from the Rest of the World with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. B — Practise Kenyan Contemporary Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. A — Practise Contemporary Songs from Kenya with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. D — Practise Music Notation Software. with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. B — Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. B — Practise Instrumental Transpositions with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. C — Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. A — Practise Western Ensembles with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Instrumental Transpositions; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Four-Part Harmony; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Music Notation Software.; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
